prompt: Create an original 90 second Chinese plucked-string ensemble instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: pipa, yangqin, dizi, frame drum. Style: crisp plucked ostinato with bright bamboo-flute answers. Tempo approximately 110 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A serene and elegant traditional East Asian instrumental piece, featuring a prominent plucked string melody, accompanied by flute and light percussion.
description.zh: 一首宁静而优雅的东亚传统器乐曲，以突出的弹拨弦乐旋律为主，辅以长笛和轻柔的打击乐。
